assessment.impact: Runtime provider connectivity only; no code or data-contract changes.

evidence.observed_failure: POST /api/documents/{id}/read returned 502 OCR_PROVIDER_ERROR while the server ran in a restricted sandbox.
evidence.provider_probe: A no-document OpenAI Responses probe completed after running outside the sandbox.
evidence.remediation: Restarted the local FastAPI server with authorized outbound network access.

outcome: Local OCR provider connection restored. User must retry document reading through the running browser app.
